lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A highly regular grid-like array of high-luminance circular spots is visible across the lateral flank. Spots are arranged in approximately parallel vertical columns and horizontal rows, maintaining consistent inter-spot distances.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with the centers of the circular spots. These vertical bands and the horizontal arrangement of spots create a distinct lattice or grid pattern on the flank surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a distinct luminance gradient with light pixels on the dorsal edge and a cast shadow immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible posterior margin of the dorsal fin exhibits a scattered distribution of high-luminance spots, which are smaller in diameter and more densely clustered than those on the primary lateral flank.
